failure.title: Native Screen coverage lacked the safe-area boundary test double
failure.note: The retained component test reached react-native-safe-area-context during collection and failed on unsupported Flow syntax before any test ran.
failure.diagnosis: The isolated native component suite newly imported Screen but did not provide the local safe-area host double already used by route suites, so Node parsed the package's Flow-typed implementation instead of the owned test boundary.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
